title_or_table: Table 4a. Reported Voting and Registration of the Total Voting-Age Population, for States: November 2024; and Table 4a. Reported Voting and Registration for States: November 2020
table_id: Voting and Registration in the Election of November 2024 (page p20-590; files under p20/587, vote04a_2024.xlsx); Voting and Registration in the Election of November 2020 (p20-585, table04a.xlsx)
geography: 50 states and the District of Columbia
universe_or_base: Citizens 18 and over in the Current Population Survey (the citizen voting-age population). voted_pct is the percent of that population who reported voting
unit: citizen_vap_thousands in thousands of people; voted_pct in percent; moe_pct is the 90 percent margin of error in percentage points ('This figure added to or subtracted from the estimate provides the 90-percent confidence interval')
vintage: 2024 tables listed on the Census voting tables page as released April 2025 (the p20-590 page was last revised August 10, 2026). 2020 page last revised October 28, 2021
qualification: Self-reported voting in a survey, among citizens 18 and over; state margins of error run from 1.6 to 5.6 points in 2024 and 1.2 to 3.7 points in 2020

voted_pct.description: percent of citizens 18 and over who reported voting

moe_pct.description: 90 percent margin of error, percentage points

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, Current Population Survey Voting and Registration Supplement, Table 4a, reported voting for states, November 2024 (and November 2020), 50 states and DC. Retrieved November 6, 2026. Self-reported voting among citizens 18 and over; state margins of error reach 5.6 points.

source_line_variants.source_line_2024_only: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, Current Population Survey Voting and Registration Supplement, Table 4a, reported voting for states, November 2024, 50 states and DC. Retrieved November 6, 2026. Self-reported voting among citizens 18 and over; state margins of error reach 5.6 points.

domain_note: Reported turnout measures who takes part, the Participation subsystem of V7 domain D10
notes: National rate, not in the CSV: 65.3% of 236,138 thousand citizens 18 and over reported voting in 2024 (margin 0.5), matching historical Table A-1
2024 range: 52.8% (Arkansas) to 79.5% (District of Columbia). 2020 range: 54.0% (Arkansas) to 84.0% (District of Columbia)
The citizen voting-age population here is the CPS survey estimate. D2-115 also names Census CVAP tables; no American Community Survey CVAP file was fetched

Code US is the national figure, read November 11, 2026 from the United States rows of Table 4a (vote04a_2024.xlsx, SHA-256 prefix 068e47d3c7fc9701; table04a.xlsx for 2020, 8afd077c560de260); a chart draws it set apart from the states and labeled (DR-64).
unconfirmed: The 2024 and 2020 release dates were read from the voting tables index and page footers, not from a press release
